item.title: Spot Deal Breakers in Job Offers 🚩 • Check for vague job descriptions—clarity is key. • Beware of unrealistic expectations in the role. • Spot inconsistent salary with industry standards. • Assess benefits—poor packages can be a red flag. • Notice high turnover rates—ask about team stability. What potential deal breakers can you identify in your current job offer? #career #joboffer #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
